I added `discount_cents: int = 0` to `Invoice` in `src/billing/invoices.py`. I didn't run any tests.

It's an integer-cents field with a default of 0, which matches the project's money convention (`subtotal_cents` and `tax_cents` are the same). The default keeps existing `Invoice(...)` calls working. I put it after `tax_cents`, so any code that passes `ledger_ref` or `lines` positionally would now bind them to the wrong fields.

`finalize()` still posts `subtotal_cents + tax_cents` to the ledger, so the discount has no effect on the posted amount yet. Changing that would alter what gets posted to the external ledger, so I left it. If you want the discount applied, the amount would become `subtotal_cents - discount_cents + tax_cents`. Say if you want that change.
